label: Sport — Peak Action
description: The decisive instant of a discipline, shot the way sports photography actually works: long glass, a shutter fast enough to freeze sweat, and a background thrown far enough back that the athlete is the only thing in focus. No venue slot: the discipline states its own environment, and an independent venue draw produced a tennis serve in a skate bowl.
